title: Turkey trots Thursday, Terranea lights its tree, and Santa's float starts rolling in Torrance
intro: Happy Thanksgiving week. Thursday has two turkey trots: Torrance's 3-mile fun run, and Long Beach's with a kids' half-mile. Friday, Manhattan Village lights its tree. Saturday, Terranea lights a tree on the bluff with Santa and a train. Sunday, Cabrillo has a holiday market with Santa, and the Torrance Santa Float starts its 22-night tour. The last free Long Beach tree-lighting tickets drop Monday at 10 a.m. Parking, food, and prices are blank unless an official page confirmed them.

picks.name: Torrance Turkey Trot (Harry Sutter Memorial Fun Run)
picks.when: Thursday, November 26 (Thanksgiving), 8:00 a.m. 3-mile fun run. Race-day check-in and registration 6:30–7:30 a.m.; prize drawing 9:15 a.m.
picks.address: Lowe's parking lot off Skypark Drive (start/finish, city rec page). Race-day packet pickup: Sam's Club lot, Torrance Crossroads, 2601 Skypark Drive (Discover Torrance).
picks.cost_math: Online registration (from $35 per runner) is now closed on the city's rec site. Discover Torrance lists race-day check-in and registration 6:30–7:30 a.m., but we couldn't load a day-of price on an official page, so no total. If all four run, it's at least 4 × $35 = $140. Cheering from the sidelines is free.
picks.parking: Not confirmed. The city's turkey trot page blocked our check.
picks.food: Not listed. Go home and eat.
picks.why: A low-key 3-mile family run, all ages, with a prize drawing after. Done by 10:30 and home for the turkey.

picks.price_text: Kids 1/2-mile $35; 5K/10K $55 (cash only at packet pickup and day-of)
picks.name: Long Beach Turkey Trot and Kids 1/2-Mile Wingding
picks.when: Thursday, November 26 (Thanksgiving). Kids 1/2-mile: 8:40 a.m. (ages 8–12) and 8:50 a.m. (7 and younger). 5K/10K starts 7:30 and 9:10 a.m.
picks.address: Granada Ave. boat launch ramp, 5000 E Ocean Blvd
picks.cost_math: Kids 1/2-mile is $35 per kid, cash only at packet pickup and day-of (organizer): 2 × $35 = $70, using free street parking. Parents running with the kids register for the Wingding too (4 × $35 = $140). 5K/10K is $55 cash. Beach lot parking is extra.
picks.parking: Beachfront lots with kiosks (about $2/hour) or free street parking (organizer); 2nd St. meters usually free on Thanksgiving.
picks.food: Hundreds of holiday pies given away (organizer).
picks.why: Flat beachfront course and a short kids' race before the feast. Bring cash if you haven't signed up.

picks.name: Manhattan Village Holiday Tree Lighting
picks.when: Friday, November 27, 4:00–6:00 p.m. (RSVP on the mall's page)
picks.cost_math: Free; RSVP on the mall's event page. Parking not listed on the event page, so no total.
picks.parking: Not listed on the event page.
picks.food: Mall restaurants. Mall hours Friday 8 a.m.–8 p.m. (official).
picks.why: Live entertainment, holiday performances, and the tree lights up. An easy Black Friday stop that isn't about shopping.

picks.price_text: $32 ages 13+, $15 ages 5–12, free 4 and under (plus fees)
picks.name: Terranea Tree Lighting Ceremony
picks.cost_math: Advance registration required (official). With kids 5–12: 2 × $32 + 2 × $15 = $94, plus fees. Kids 4 and under are free (2 × $32 = $64 plus fees). Resort parking not listed, so no total.
picks.food: Hot chocolate and cider stations, decorated cookies for purchase, grab-and-go bites, and a cash bar (official).
picks.why: A 30-foot tree on the bluff at sunset, Santa and Mrs. Claus photos, a trackless train, and postcards to the North Pole. Bring an unwrapped toy for Toys for Tots.

picks.price_text: Nov 27–29 (holiday peak): $35 adults 13+, $25 kids 2–12; under 2 free
picks.name: L.A. Zoo Lights
picks.when: Friday–Sunday, November 27–29 (closed Thanksgiving and Monday, November 30). Timed entry; box office 5:45–8:45 p.m. on event nights. Runs select nights through January 10.
picks.cost_math: Holiday-peak pricing Nov 27–29 (official FAQ): 2 × $35 + 2 × $25 = $120, service fee included. Parking is free (official). Cheaper on value nights: weekdays Dec 2, 3, 8–10 are $29/$19 → $96.
picks.food: Concessions on site; outside food not checked.
picks.why: The zoo after dark in lights. Most families take 60–90 minutes. The skating rink is a separate ticket.

picks.name: Holiday Market at Cabrillo Marine Aquarium
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M White Dr
picks.cost_math: Free market. The aquarium is free with a suggested donation ($10 adults, $5 kids), not required (official). Parking: $3/hour up to $9, or a $9 flat fee on special event days, card only (official) → about $9.
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot: $3/hour, $9 daily max; $9 flat on special event days; card only (official).
picks.food: Pizzas by Miller Butler and Offset Coffee Cart (official).
picks.why: 30+ local makers, live music, and a Santa visit by the beach. Walk off the pie on the pier, then stay for the free 1 p.m. Walk Cabrillo.

picks.name: Riviera Village Holiday Stroll
picks.address: Riviera Village, S Catalina Ave (Avenue I to S Elena closed to cars)
picks.cost_math: Free to attend. Parking is metered or paid (price not listed), so no total.
picks.parking: Metered lot and street meters, paid parking at Plaza Riviera (1611 S Catalina Ave) and Mira Mar Park (201 Paseo de la Playa). Rates not listed (organizer).
picks.why: The street closes for lights, music, Santa, the Grinch, and shopping.

picks.name: LA Harbor Holiday Boat Parade
picks.when: Saturday, December 5, 6:00–8:00 p.m. (about 90 minutes for the boats to pass)
picks.address: Port of Los Angeles Main Channel, Wilmington to San Pedro
picks.cost_math: Free to watch from shore (official). Parking depends on where you watch; not listed.
picks.parking: Not listed. Viewing spots include the Cruise Ship Promenade (Harbor Blvd. & Swinford St.), LA Maritime Museum (600 Sampson Way), West Harbor (1100 Nagoya Way), and Banning's Landing in Wilmington (official).
picks.food: Not listed; West Harbor restaurants are near several viewing spots.
picks.why: Lit-up boats cruise the Main Channel from Wilmington toward San Pedro. 64th year.

picks.name: Aquarium Holidays at the Aquarium of the Pacific
picks.when: Saturday, December 5 through Sunday, December 20. Surfer Santa every weekend; Hanukkah and Kwanzaa storytelling December 12–13.
picks.address: Aquarium of the Pacific, 100 Aquarium Way
picks.cost_math: Included with general admission (official): 2 × $49.95 + 2 × $34.95 = $169.80, plus $8 validated parking = $177.80, about $178. Under 3 free. Reservations required.
picks.parking: Aquarium Parking Structure: $8 for the day with Aquarium validation (official).
picks.food: Aquarium cafe, or The Pike and Shoreline Village nearby.
picks.why: Surfer Santa photos on weekends, Elf in the Kelp daily, holiday decorations, and holiday films.

picks.name: Let It Snow! Holiday Festival & Memorial Tree Lighting
picks.cost_math: Free admission to all listed activities (organizer). Face painting is limited. Parking not listed, so no total.
picks.why: Snow sledding, sleigh rides, Santa photos, crafts, and ornament decorating, all free. A real snow day without the drive.

picks.name: Torrance Santa Float neighborhood tour begins
picks.when: Sunday, November 29, route starts 4:00 p.m. (Map 9: PCH to Winlock/Rolling Hills Way to Hawthorne and west of DePortola Park). Then nightly through December 20.
picks.address: Your street. Check the 2026 schedule and route maps on the TPOA page.
picks.cost_math: Free. It comes to you, so no parking.
picks.why: Santa rolls through every Torrance neighborhood over 22 nights. Find your night on the TPOA schedule. The start time is when the route begins, not when it hits your block.

picks.name: Madrona Marsh Nature Walk
picks.when: Saturday, November 28, 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. (Nature Center closed Thanksgiving and Friday)
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza del Amo
picks.cost_math: Free, no registration (official). Parking not listed.
picks.why: An easy docent-led walk to spot birds and plants. A 9 a.m. bird walk runs the same morning.

picks.name: Biobuzz Bash at Cabrillo Marine Aquarium
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M White Dr
picks.cost_math: Free and open to all ages (official). Parking $3/hour up to $9, card only (official) → $9 max.
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot: $3/hour, $9 daily max; card only (official).
picks.why: A high school robotics team brings its robots and hands-on STEM activities.

picks.name: Walk Cabrillo
picks.address: Starts in the Cabrillo Marine Aquarium courtyard, 3720 Stephen M White Dr
picks.cost_math: Free; kids must be with an adult (official). Parking $3/hour up to $9, or $9 flat on special event days, card only (official) → $9 max.
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot: $3/hour, $9 daily max; card only (official).
picks.food: Pack a snack (official). Holiday Market food trucks are on site until 3 p.m. the same day.
picks.why: Educators lead you through the native garden, salt marsh, beach, and tidepools. Fossils and beach finds.

picks.name: Visit Long Beach Christmas Tree Lighting (last free ticket drop Monday)
picks.when: Monday, December 7, 5:00–8:00 p.m. Last ticket drop: Monday, November 30 at 10 a.m.
picks.address: Terrace Theater Plaza, 300 E Ocean Blvd
picks.cost_math: Free, but tickets are required, limit four per person (official). Long Beach Convention & Entertainment Center garages are $15 per day (official) → $15.
picks.parking: Four Convention & Entertainment Center garages (Terrace Theater garage at 66 Collins Way, Main Lot, Arena garage, Promenade garage at 70 S Pine Ave): $15 per day, no in-and-out (official).
picks.food: Food trucks and seasonal treats (official). Prices not listed.
picks.why: A 67-foot tree, falling snow, Nutcracker dancers, free train rides, Santa photos, and fireworks. Set an alarm for Monday 10 a.m.

picks.name: Redondo Beach Tree & Menorah Lighting
picks.when: Tuesday, December 8. Tree lighting 4:30 p.m., menorah lighting 5:35 p.m.
picks.address: Redondo Beach City Hall, 415 Diamond St
picks.cost_math: Free; complimentary hot chocolate, sweets, latkes, and jelly donuts (City of Redondo Beach). Parking not listed.
picks.food: Complimentary hot chocolate, sweets, latkes, and jelly donuts (official).
picks.why: Two lightings in one evening, with Redondo school choirs and bands.

picks.name: Skechers Manhattan Beach Holiday Fireworks
picks.when: Sunday, December 13, 3:00–8:00 p.m.; fireworks at 7:00 p.m. (rain or shine, barring severe weather)
picks.cost_math: Free. Snow Park entry (4–6 p.m. for the public) is a donated unwrapped toy or canned food item (official). Parking not listed.
picks.parking: Not listed on the event site; downtown streets close for the event.
picks.food: Downtown restaurants; bring a picnic for the beach.
picks.why: Snow Park for kids, a Santa float on Manhattan Avenue, carolers, and fireworks over the pier.
